irs.author: jesterdyne (CC0 1.0 — no attribution required)
irs.notes: mix-ready 4x12 guitar cab — modded Behringer BG412S with Celestion V30 and Eminence DV77, SM57 close-mic. Upstream: converted to 48 kHz / 24-bit / stereo WAV; mono source duplicated to both channels; peak-normalized to -6 dBFS. tail left untrimmed — cab IRs ship pre-truncated by their creators. Here one identical channel extracted without gain, normalization, or resampling. Original download requires login; original hash unavailable.
